verdict.rationale: Choosing a funding model is a fair question for a card-issuing platform. However, the evidence never mentions prefunded balances, just-in-time funding, or any documented cash-flow tradeoffs. ASA lets your system make custom approval decisions on each authorization, but that is authorization control, not a funding model, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented
